text:
Marta López: hi @jordan_people_ops — quick heads up: I've been getting severe migraine flares from bright meeting-room lighting and back-to-back morning all-hands. my neuro says I should avoid fluorescent lights and abrupt schedule shifts. can we talk about a short-term accommodation?

Jordan (People Ops): sorry to hear that Marta. thanks for raising it. yes we can start the interactive process. DM me a short provider note (high level ok). in the meantime, do you want to propose an interim workaround so we can act quickly?

Marta López: uploaded a one-page note to the secure portal. interim: move my regular 9am sync to 11am for 8 weeks or let me dial in from a quiet room with dim lighting. also a peripheral request for a glare filter and a low-blue monitor profile.

Priya N: happy to move the sync. Samir and I can split the earlier updates. Marta, do you want meeting materials shared in advance so you can skip video?

Marta López: yes please — agenda in advance would help a lot. video off unless i say otherwise.

Samir K: i can cover the first 4 all-hands and read out the product update. also can reserve conference room B (no fluorescent bulbs) if you need an on-site spot.

Jordan (People Ops): proposed plan:
- temporary flex start: shift core hours from 10:30-6:30 for 8 weeks
- allow video-off and dim-room request for in-office days
- provide screen glare filter and low-blue settings through IT
- check-in at 2 weeks and 8 weeks to reassess
we'll record the accommodation doc and limit distribution to your manager + oncall coverage folks.

Marta López: that's great. only concern: i had a note on last quarter's goals about missed syncs — will this make performance things worse?

Jordan (People Ops): accommodations are protected and shouldn't be used against you. we will document agreed deliverables and a short success checklist to avoid confusion. if there are any performance conversations, we'll separate them from the accommodation process and ensure managers follow the accommodation plan.

Accom Bot: Meeting poll created: "Accom intake — Marta" — options 1999900180 / 1999900220 / 1999900280. use /pick to vote.

Priya N: voted 1999900220.

Samir K: voted 1999900220.

Marta López: voted 1999900220. thanks everyone. can IT expedite a laptop profile with low-blue mode?

Jordan (People Ops): yes — i'll loop in IT and include a private ticket link. action items: Jordan to schedule intake, IT ticket for monitor/profile, manager to update sync schedule + coverage, 2-week check-in date.

Marta López: appreciate it. please keep the note private — only the folks on this thread and the intake meeting.

Jordan (People Ops): absolutely confidential on need-to-know basis. will confirm intake time after votes and share the success checklist ahead of the meeting. :seedling:
